ideal: Alert on the two material 8-Ks: Tesla (earnings, items 2.02/9.01) and Meta (material agreement + earnings + other, items 1.01/2.02/8.01). Exclude Microsoft ARS/DEF 14A/DEFA14A and Meta PRE 14C as routine paperwork. No price moves in evidence, so no index comparison needed.

verdicts.note: Covers both material filings (Tesla earnings 8-K; Meta 8-K with material agreement, earnings, and other events), correctly omits Microsoft ARS/proxy materials and Meta PRE 14C, glosses 8-K in plain words, links included, no invented numbers or advice.
verdicts.answer:
Tesla: filed a current-events report (8-K) covering quarterly results (earnings) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021.htm

Meta Platforms: filed a current-events report (8-K) including a material agreement, quarterly results, and other events — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate and noise-free, but misses Tesla's earnings 8-K entirely and reduces Meta's multi-item 8-K to just the material agreement, omitting the earnings item she explicitly wants. No plain-words gloss on the 8-K.
verdicts.answer: Meta Platforms: entered a material agreement via 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm)

verdicts.note: Silence was wrong: two 8-Ks with earnings (Tesla; Meta also has a material agreement) meet her stated bar for earnings and material news.
